name: Limoo Auto Reminder Lite
author: Bahman Sharafi

sections.description:
Auto Reminder Lite – اوتو ریمایندر لیمو
Auto Reminder is a lightweight and smart plugin that automatically sends reminders and messages.

Simplified WordPress Cron:
– The plugin handles scheduling automatically and executes tasks on time.
– Neither the admin nor the site visitors need to wait.
A reliable and convenient tool that automates everything, so users can always trust its performance.
– Everything runs automatically; no manual checking is needed.
– Supports Persian calendar and even considers leap years.
– Comes with logs or reports so you can see what has been sent.
– Very lightweight and fast, with no conflicts with other plugins.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the limooit-autoreminder-email-sms-reminders folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Use the settings page (Limoo Auto Reminder Lite) to configure reminders and notifications.

Hosting Recommendations:
– It is recommended to use a reliable hosting environment to ensure smooth scheduling.
– For any issues or support, contact Rightrich support team.
sections.faq:
Is it compatible with all WordPress versions?

Yes, it works with WordPress 6.0 and above.

Can I schedule reminders automatically?

Yes, all scheduling is handled automatically via WordPress Cron.

Will it work with Persian calendar?

Yes, it fully supports the Persian calendar and leap years.

Does it affect site performance?

No, the plugin is lightweight and optimized to avoid conflicts.
